models.plan: A plan with title, description, duration in days, type (bible, devotional, topical), and optional thumbnail.
models.planDay: A single day within a plan, with an ordered list of content items.
models.dayContent: A content item for a day: video, audio, written message, or passage. Has type, optional refs, text, or mediaUrl.
models.userPlanProgress: User's progress on a plan: planId, status (active, saved, completed), completedDayIds, currentDayNumber.
models.category: A thematic or content-type category for discoverability (e.g., New to Faith, Lent & Easter).

plans.title: Walking With John
plans.description: A 14-day journey through the Gospel of John. Each day includes a short devotional reflection and key passages. Perfect for new believers or anyone wanting to deepen their understanding of Jesus' life and teachings.
plans.author: Senga Ministry

plans.title: Peace: A 5-Day Devotional
plans.description: Discover peace in God's presence. This short plan explores Galatians 5:22 and related passages, with daily reflections on the fruit of the Spirit.
plans.author: Pastor Senga

plans.title: The Story Did Not End There
plans.description: A 5-day study on Jacob's journey in Genesis 34–35. Reflect on God's faithfulness when life takes unexpected turns. Includes audio summaries for each day.
plans.author: Sara Lingel

plans.title: Exodus & Ephesians
plans.description: A 12-week (84-day) Bible reading plan through Exodus and the Pauline epistles, with Psalms woven in. Each week has an audio recap.
plans.author: Senga Ministry

plans.title: Answers to Anxiety
plans.description: A 5-day study by Joyce Meyer on finding peace in God's Word. Each day includes a short video teaching and scripture passages.
plans.author: Joyce Meyer

plans.title: Faith That Endures
plans.description: A 47-day Lenten journey through Hebrews 11–12. Reflect on the cloud of witnesses and run the race with perseverance.
plans.author: Bob Hoskins
